user_story: As a user, I want the login endpoint to return an error when the email field is empty so that I provide all required credentials.

positive.title: Successful login with valid credentials
steps: Send login request with valid email and password
Check if the login is successful
positive.expected_result: Login is successful and returns a success message.

negative.title: Error returned when email field is empty
steps: Send login request with empty email field and valid password
Check the response from the login endpoint
negative.expected_result: Login fails and returns an error message indicating the email field is required.

edge.title: Error returned when email field is blank but with spaces
steps: Send login request with email field containing only spaces and valid password
Check the response from the login endpoint
edge.expected_result: Login fails and returns an error message indicating the email field is required.
